title: A quantum-operator analysis of N-fold phase accumulation in coherence de Broglie wavelength interferometry
summary: Quantum sensing exploits nonclassical states of light, including multiphoton entangled states and squeezed states, to achieve superresolution and/or super-sensitivity. However, its practical implementation is constrained by state-generation complexity, photon loss, and detection efficiency. Here, we present a quantum-operator analysis of coherence de Broglie wavelength (CBW) in an anti-symmetrically coupled Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) architecture and clarify the origin of its superresolution and enhanced phase sensitivity.
